title: Mermaid Roshan and the Song Beneath the Pool

architecture: Cover page 1; 30 story pages 2–31; illustrated quiet back page 32. All are actual PDF pages.
editorial_principle: Every small city job plants a later skill or prop. Listening drives the mystery; careful teamwork frees Duri; Duri becomes the guide; a playful physical fight clears access rather than magically solving the repair. The repaired existing current carries everyone's song.

pages.script: Mermaid Roshan and the Song Beneath the Pool

pages.beat: Pool invitation; Roshan worries about being unheard
pages.script: The castle's candle was still missing. But Rumi's pool shimmered, and the rainbow kept turning. ‘Come to our evening song,’ said Rumi. Roshan tucked her chin into her collar. ‘What if nobody hears me?’ ‘Then I will,’ said Rumi. She held out her hand.

pages.beat: Large under-pool city reveal, clearly within Pearl Castle
pages.script: Down they swam, through the shining oval beneath the pool. Curved roofs rose beside pearl bridges. Shop windows glowed peach and gold. A bubble tram sailed between tall lavender homes. ‘We're still in the castle?’ whispered Roshan. ‘Every bit,’ said Rumi.

pages.beat: Living city: Roshan helps catch a drifting parcel basket, learning to follow current rather than rush
pages.script: At the tram stop, a basket drifted away from a neighbour. Roshan rushed after it. WHOOSH! Her tail sent it farther. ‘Try following the ribbon,’ said Rumi. Roshan slowed, curved beneath the basket and lifted it gently. ‘Much better,’ she said.

pages.beat: Small courier job and Duri absence clue; bells travel from market to music room
pages.script: Inside were little pearl bells for the music room. ‘Duri usually brings them,’ said the neighbour. ‘I haven't heard his tapping today.’ ‘We'll take this basket,’ Roshan offered. She and Rumi followed the shell pictures past curved rooftops, glowing shops and hanging seaweed gardens.

pages.beat: Meet Hana and Nari through the delivery, keeping their established original designs
pages.script: Hana swept out of the music room, copper hair floating behind her. Nari peeped round the doorway. ‘Bells!’ she cheered. ‘And a new friend,’ said Rumi. ‘I'm Roshan.’ ‘I'm Hana. I dance BIG.’ ‘I'm Nari. I hear tiny things.’ ‘I'm glad,’ Roshan said.

pages.beat: Stage preparation job plants loose fabric loop, gentle handling, tiny note, and later soft-star catch
pages.script: They hung a soft banner behind the shell microphones. Hana stretched it tight. A corner slipped. Roshan caught it. ‘Leave a little room,’ she said. Rumi tied a loose loop. Nari tested a bell. Ding. Roshan tried one tiny note. ‘I heard that,’ Nari whispered.

pages.beat: The first trio song gets no customary answer; establish communal current-singing
pages.script: The trio began: ‘Little voice, big blue sea. Sing with you, sing with me.’ Usually, the shops answered, then the bathhouse, then the tram. Today the last note floated away alone. Rumi lowered her microphone. ‘Where is everybody?’

pages.beat: Roshan changes the group's behavior: stop and listen rather than louder singing
pages.script: Hana drew a breath to sing louder. Roshan raised one hand. ‘Wait.’ Between the notes came something very small. Tap. Tap. Tap. ‘A bell?’ asked Nari. ‘No,’ said Roshan. ‘Someone knocking.’ The friends held still. This time, everyone heard it.

pages.beat: Swimming puzzle follows bubbles under tram bridge; Hana learns to fold her fin and slow down
pages.script: The tapping led beneath the pearl tram bridge. Roshan followed the bubbles around a pillar. Hana started through a narrow opening. Her big fin brushed the wall. ‘Slow tails,’ Rumi reminded them. Nari listened again. ‘Below us.’ Four little faces peered into the alcove.

pages.beat: Find Duri trapped between two crates under soft banner, not injury or crushing
pages.script: Two concert crates pressed close together. Between them was a lavender turtle with a mint-flower shell. A soft banner looped round its edge. ‘I'm Duri,’ he said. ‘I came to move these. Then they slid.’ Roshan crouched beside him. ‘We're here now.’

pages.beat: First push tightens banner; immediately stop and plan cloth release before moving the crate
pages.script: Hana pushed the nearest crate. Duri squeaked. Everyone stopped. ‘The banner pulls when the crate moves,’ Roshan said. Rumi checked the loose cloth. ‘I can lift this loop first.’ ‘Then I'll move the crate,’ said Roshan. Hana nodded. ‘Tell me when. I'll hold the other one.’

pages.beat: Roshan and Rumi perform clear two-part rescue; Hana steadies, Nari counts
pages.script: Rumi slipped the cloth over the edge of Duri's shell. Roshan braced both hands against the crate. Nari counted softly. ‘One. Two. Gently.’ Roshan pushed sideways. Hana kept the second crate steady. A little space opened. ‘Can you move your flippers?’ Roshan asked.

pages.beat: Rescue release and relationship payoff; recover courier satchel
pages.script: One flipper. Two flippers. Duri wriggled forward. Then POP! He was free. Rumi caught his dropped satchel. Roshan held out her hand. ‘You heard me,’ Duri said. ‘You kept tapping,’ she answered. Nari tapped the crate in reply. Tap. Tap. Tap.

pages.beat: Bathhouse recovery; useful quiet midpoint, Duri and Roshan connect emotionally
pages.script: They brought Duri to the warm-current bathhouse. Mint tiles shone under tiny bubbles. Hana offered a pearl cushion. Rumi checked his satchel. Roshan sat close. Duri's flippers still trembled. ‘I thought the city had forgotten me,’ he said. Roshan knew how that felt.

pages.beat: Roshan leads comfort song; Hana waits and joins gently, Nari supports
pages.script: Roshan sang softly: ‘Make a space and let it through. There's a place for me and you.’ Nari hummed the little tune. Duri tapped one flipper against the cushion. Hana waited before joining. Soon there was room for every note. Duri's trembling stopped.

pages.beat: Imps in established performer/magician costumes explicitly hog stage; Duri recognizes props
pages.script: A top hat bobbed past the doorway. POOF! A magician imp appeared. A glitter-jacket imp followed, hauling another crate. ‘Our enormous, magnificent show!’ he announced. ‘No other singers allowed!’ Duri pointed. ‘Those are the props blocking our current channel.’ The imps hurried towards the shell stage.

pages.beat: Investigate existing magic current arch; crates explain missing responses
pages.script: Beneath the stage, three crates crowded a golden current arch. Its blue light still glowed, but the hanging ribbons barely moved. ‘The magic is here,’ said Rumi. ‘The song can't travel through.’ Roshan spotted a narrow ribbon of water beneath the lowest crate.

pages.beat: Duri's courier expertise guides service passage; Nari gains confidence calling directions
pages.script: ‘I know a way in,’ Duri said. ‘I deliver parcels here.’ He showed them a sheltered passage behind the bridge. Hana folded her big fin close. Nari checked each turn by listening. This time she spoke clearly. ‘Left here!’ Roshan followed. Little things made a useful path.

pages.beat: Practical swim/push puzzle plan: sideways path, loose loop, roles, safe prop storage
pages.script: At the passage's end, Roshan studied the crates. ‘That one can slide sideways.’ Rumi checked the banner loop. Hana found room to push. Nari tested a fabric handle. Duri pointed out a clear place for the props. ‘We can fix it,’ Roshan said. ‘First, let's ask.’

pages.beat: Assertive negotiation and imp motive; invitation to share rejected
pages.script: They swam onto the shell stage. ‘Your crates trapped Duri,’ said Roshan. ‘And they're blocking the city's song.’ The performer imp puffed out his jacket. ‘Our show needs enormous props!’ ‘It needs neighbours too,’ said Rumi. ‘There's room for your show and everyone else's voices.’

pages.beat: Imps physically block repair with toy bubbles and soft foam star; prepare playful battle
pages.script: ‘We'll move these to the side,’ Roshan said. The magician waved his hat. ‘Nobody touches our spectacular scenery!’ POOF! Bubbles poured between her and the gate. The performer tossed a soft foam star. Hana caught the banner's corner. ‘Now we need our big moves.’

pages.beat: Trio sings, dances and drums to keep approach clear while Roshan swims to repair
pages.script: Rumi took the first note. Hana lifted the banner like a bright sail. Nari tapped the shell drum. Together the trio swept into a dancing turn. Roshan slipped along the stage edge. ‘I'll get to the crate!’ she called. ‘We'll keep this way clear,’ Rumi answered.

pages.beat: Bubble-cloud swimming puzzle; Nari's tiny hearing and Roshan's slow current-following pay off
pages.script: The bubble cloud hid the gate. Roshan paused. Nari stopped one drumbeat and listened. ‘There's water moving through the bottom!’ Roshan ducked beneath the bubbles. Above her, Rumi spun clear of the magician's puff. ‘Little voice, big blue sea!’ Hana held the banner ready.

pages.beat: Real playful physical battle: foam star caught/bounced; two imps land safely on padded cushions
pages.script: WHOOSH! The foam star flew. Hana caught it in the soft banner. Nari ducked, then bounced it gently back. The performer tumbled onto his padded cushions. The magician tried another grand puff. It spun his hat backwards. BUMP! He landed beside his friend.

pages.beat: Account for two small crates moved aside, then Roshan tries last crate and asks for help
pages.script: Rumi and Nari slid two small crates to the side. Hana steadied them. Roshan looped the banner through the last crate's handle. She pulled. It moved a little, then stopped. ‘I need you!’ she called. Duri checked the clear space. Her friends took their places.

pages.beat: Clear last crate physically together; preserve exact geometry and existing current rather than casting a spell
pages.script: ‘Hana, push. Rumi, with me. Nari, count.’ ‘One. Two. Gently!’ The crate slid sideways. A blue ribbon of current curled through the open arch. Duri swam after it. The other crates were already clear. ‘There,’ Roshan breathed. The magic had been there all along.

pages.beat: Neighbors answer through locations visited earlier; Duri becomes an active musical courier
pages.script: The current reached the shops. One little voice answered. Then another. Duri tapped at a window and hurried on towards the tram. The bathhouse hummed. The bridge ribbons fluttered. ‘Listen!’ said Nari. Roshan smiled. This time the city had plenty to say.

pages.beat: Imps understand their exclusion caused no audience; apology plus physical repair, not instant pardon
pages.script: The imps peeked over their cushions. ‘No one came to our show,’ said the performer. ‘You blocked their way,’ Roshan said. The magician looked at Duri. ‘We didn't mean to trap you.’ Together they stacked their crates at the side. ‘Can we help now?’

pages.beat: Big shared-city encore; original complete refrain, all voices and voluntary imp participation
pages.script: ‘Leave everyone a space,’ Roshan said. The magician rang a pearl bell. The performer took a bow. Rumi, Hana and Nari sang, and Roshan joined them: ‘Little voice, big blue sea. Sing with you, sing with me. Make a space and let it through. There's a place for me and you.’

pages.beat: Quiet pool homecoming echoes opening; missing-candle larger plot remains open
pages.script: At last, Roshan and Rumi swam home. The seahorse fountain splashed. Above the pool, the familiar rainbow turned. ‘We haven't found the candle yet,’ Roshan said. ‘No,’ said Rumi. ‘But today, you heard a friend.’ Roshan listened. Far below came a little goodnight. Tap. Tap. Tap.

continuity_notes: Duri is mentioned before rescue but only visually introduced trapped on page 11, so corrected prior images remain usable.
All action remains beneath the castle pool, not a voyage away from the castle.
Use Hana/Nari existing cast identity; no new costume changes or copied film designs.
The soft banner is a useful recurring tool, not a new magic object or binding weapon.
Roshan and Rumi perform Duri's decisive rescue; Hana/Nari help without replacing them.
Hana's arc: big first impulse, learns to wait/fold fin, then big moves are useful in battle.
Nari's arc: quietly notices Roshan's note, gains confidence directing service route and fight route.
Duri's arc: unheard and trapped, reassured by quiet song, becomes helpful guide and active messenger.
Roshan's arc: worries she will be unheard, listens and asks for help, ends with her voice among neighbors rather than becoming loudest.
Page 26 explicitly moves two small crates aside before the last crate; page 27 needs exact same side-storage geometry, with no blocking copies left behind.
